name: Himeno Tsugumi
source:
A junior one year younger than the protagonist, belonging to the home economics club at the academy, she’s a homely girl.

Lacking athletic ability, she’s clumsy, prone to mistakes, and easily flustered with a tendency to blush.

Despite her frequent failures, her earnest and unyielding nature makes her well-liked by those around her.

At their part-time job, she’s technically the protagonist's senpai and tasked with guiding him, but often ends up being the one helped by him instead.

“Next time, I’ll sneak a kiss and totally surprise you!”

[spoiler] In Dousei, Tsugumi is now a 3rd year student and Haruki is a university student. 2 years has passed. [/spoiler]
